method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify L as the river and locate the contour labelled x and the position of point a relative to the neighbouring contours. Use the river-crossing pattern to decide that elevation increases from the x contour toward the side containing the next contour, so the adjacent contour value is 600 m. Since a is visually located between the x=500 m contour and the 600 m contour and is not on either line, conclude that its elevation is between 500 m and 600 m.
